questions.question: If someone is tailgating you, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Let the vehicle pass.
questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, give them space to pass. This is safer. Driving faster does not help because they may tailgate you at the higher speed, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: How do you release the parking brake?

options.text: Tap the brake pedal three times
Push in the brake control knob

questions.correctAnswerText: Push in the brake control knob
questions.explanation: In newer vehicles with air brakes, the parking brake is controlled by a yellow diamond-shaped knob. Pull the knob out to engage the parking brake. Push it in to release the parking brake.

questions.question: Why does a lightly-loaded combination vehicle stop more slowly than a fully-loaded vehicle?

options.text: Stiff suspension springs and strong brakes create high traction.
Stiff suspension springs and strong brakes create low traction.
The brakes only work when a trailer reaches a minimum weight.
The suspension springs only work when a trailer reaches a minimum weight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stiff suspension springs and strong brakes create low traction.
questions.explanation: An empty combination vehicle stops more slowly than a fully-loaded vehicle. The stiff suspension springs and strong brakes have lower traction with a light trailer than with a heavy load.

questions.question: When does the automatic tractor protection valve pop out?

options.text: When air pressure drops between 20 and 45 psi
When air pressure drops between 75 and 105 psi
When air pressure drops between 50 and 65 psi

questions.correctAnswerText: When air pressure drops between 20 and 45 psi
questions.explanation: The automatic tractor protection valve pops out when air pressure drops between 20 and 45 psi. When the valve pops out, it closes and stops the flow of air.

questions.question: If you feel sleepy while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Continue driving to finish the trip.
Drive faster to reach your destination sooner.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and take a nap.
questions.explanation: If you feel sleepy while driving, stop and sleep. Trying to fight exhaustion is dangerous and causes crashes. Energy pills may keep you awake but will not make you alert. When they wear off, you will be even more tired.

questions.question: What should be true about the leaves on a leaf spring?
questions.correctAnswerText: They should not be broken.
questions.explanation: When inspecting a vehicle's suspension, check for broken or missing leaves in the leaf springs. This is dangerous. If one-fourth or more of the leaves are missing from any leaf spring, take the vehicle out of service.

questions.question: What can a trailer brake hand valve be used for?

options.text: Stop the truck from rolling back when starting from a stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop the truck from rolling back when starting from a stop
questions.explanation: If the tractor-trailer has a trailer brake hand valve, you can use it to prevent the vehicle from rolling back when starting from a stop.

questions.question: What is traction?

options.text: Grip between the tires and the road
How long it takes to apply the brakes

questions.correctAnswerText: Grip between the tires and the road
questions.explanation: Traction is the grip between your tires and the road. Good traction is necessary for braking and steering.

questions.question: When testing ____, apply the brakes with the hand control while moving forward slowly.
questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer service brakes
questions.explanation: To test the trailer service brakes, first make sure the air pressure is normal and the parking brake is released. Move forward slowly and use the hand control to apply the brakes. If they work, you will feel the brakes engage.

questions.question: How much space should there be between the upper and lower fifth wheel?
questions.correctAnswerText: No space
questions.explanation: Before a trip, inspect all couplings. There should be no space between the upper and lower fifth wheel.

questions.question: In a vehicle with dual air brakes, a leak in one system ____ the second system.
questions.correctAnswerText: May not affect
questions.explanation: Dual air brake systems have two separate systems. A leak in one system may not affect the other.

questions.question: When air tanks reach 125 psi, the air compressor governor will:

options.text: Stop the compressor from pumping air.
Begin pumping air into the tanks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop the compressor from pumping air.
questions.explanation: At 125 psi, the governor stops the compressor. This pressure level is called the "cut-out" level.

questions.question: If you find something unsafe during a pre-trip inspection, you should:

options.text: Continue the trip and see a mechanic after you are done.
Let a more experienced driver use the truck.
Get the issue fixed right away.
Avoid using the unsafe items, but continue driving normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get the issue fixed right away.
questions.explanation: You must fix any unsafe issue found during inspection. Driving an unsafe vehicle is illegal.

questions.question: Rough acceleration is:

options.text: Not recommended because it can damage the vehicle.
Not recommended because it may confuse other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not recommended because it can damage the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Accelerate smoothly and gradually to avoid jerking. Rough acceleration can damage your vehicle.

questions.question: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) will:

options.text: Make you stop in a shorter distance.
Not change how you apply the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not change how you apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: ABS prevents your brakes from locking up during hard braking. Brake the same way you would without ABS. It does not necessarily shorten your stopping distance.

questions.question: Emergency equipment in a vehicle is:

options.text: Only required for vehicles carrying hazardous materials.

questions.correctAnswerText: Required.
questions.explanation: Emergency equipment is required. Check for spare fuses, three red reflective triangles or flares, and at least one charged fire extinguisher during pre-trip inspection.

questions.question: If your vehicle's ABS is not working, how should you brake?

options.text: Brake normally, as your brakes will still work.
Press the brake pedal down as hard as you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brake normally, as your brakes will still work.
questions.explanation: Without ABS, your brakes will still work normally. Drive and brake as usual, and have your ABS repaired as soon as possible.

questions.question: If you unlock the pintle hook with the dolly still under the rear trailer:

options.text: The tow bar may fly up.

questions.correctAnswerText: The tow bar may fly up.
questions.explanation: Always remove the dolly from under the rear trailer before unlocking the pintle hook. This prevents the tow bar from flying up and causing injury.

questions.question: Alcohol is removed from the body:

options.text: More quickly if you stay awake.

questions.correctAnswerText: At a fixed rate.
questions.explanation: The liver removes alcohol at a fixed rate. Coffee or cold showers do not speed up this process. Only time will remove alcohol from your system.

questions.question: Wheel rims that have been welded should:

options.text: Be placed in the front of the vehicle.
Be placed in the rear of the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not be used.
questions.explanation: Welded wheels and rims are not safe to use. Replace any damaged wheels and rims.
